notes.title: DHXP 2025 Anniversary event
notes.content:
[h1]Thank you for sticking with us all these years![/h1]

It's been over a decade since we began this journey, as this month marks [i]eleven[/i] years of Digital Happiness' first-ever launched title, DreadOut. What started as a small spark has grown into a world of stories and shared memories with you, our beloved players.

Everything we've built was made with passion, sleepless nights, and LOTS of coffee. And through it all, you've been there playing, supporting, and believing in us.

DHXP is the pulse of everything we’ve created so far. And to this day, it has always been more than a celebration, it’s a thank you, a look back, and a vision of what lies ahead.

And for you, thank you for being part of this journey. Whether you’ve been here since the beginning, or you just stumbled into our world someway somehow, we're glad you're here.

[h2]Then what lies beyond the 11th year?[/h2]

This is the fun part. Currently, there are so many things going on in our headquarters, and we're so excited to share them with you. We're working on titles that you might have expected and not expected!

[previewyoutube=uYlkB3py6EE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Also check out the DHXP 2025 Steam Sale Page by clicking the banner below:[/h3]

[url=bit.ly/dhxp2025][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33371531/f6f256432d7ba3a4c98fa44749cb058a7bd9463e.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Did someone mention sale?[/h2]
Of course, we have a special sale going on too! Take a look around and dive into the games that have shaped us as a developers. You can get it with [b]up to 80% off[/b]!

Please spread the news because this offer lasts through May 24, 2025!

Hope you enjoy every bit of it!

:DH

notes.title: ⚠︎ Major FREE Update ASSAULT MODE Now Live! ⚠︎
notes.content:
[h1]Pack it in, Agents! You've just promoted to an Assault Team![/h1]

[h2]Secure The Perimeter! Spectromorphs containment is now top priority![/h2]

The fight against the s̴̜͇̖͉̎p̷̯̲͙̿̿̎e̴͎̠͐̊̅̑c̷̢̺̭̈́͊͒t̵̤̞͎̞̑̔r̶͈͛̌o̸͍̽͜m̴̛̳̠̆o̵̤͚͓̱͘r̴̲̭̿p̵̨̠̦̽̓͗̕ḩ̴̨̨̛̳̬͋̄͛̎s̴͎̓ just got more intense. Assault Mode introduces a high-stakes [b]first-person survival[/b] mode where you and your squad must hold the line against relentless waves of spectral containment fractured.

[previewyoutube=czxX6Is6fB0;full][trailer embed][/previewyoutube]

[h2]A New Special Agent Enters the Battlefield![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/06fb10ac772fbe06480747dded7c65d2c45b5c04.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/33ca27862f57b35d3667bb102e1e74e7a8c93136.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/e7fdbdfc3bfed58a0dc0c7b8136b3639f149e3ea.png[/img]

DreadHaunt is available on PC via Steam and Xbox for $19.99, with a limited-time 30% discount during the Assault Mode launch week!

Lock & Load, agents. The survival begins NOW!

notes.title: The Lanterns Lit Up With The Free Updates!
notes.content:
[h1]Gong Xi Fa Cai, Agents![/h1]

It’s time to celebrate Lunar New Year in BPSR HQ! The Year of the Snake has arrived, bring along prosperity, joy, and thrilling new updates for you to enjoy. Let’s dive into it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/f55e607b3fefc23d281c228ecd32a1d93c199459.png[/img]
[h2]Your Lunar New Year Gift is Here![/h2]

This time, every agent gets a special gift from HQ! Inside, you’ll find Lunar New Year-themed costumes designed to bring good fortune and festive vibes to your missions. Head to your locker and don’t miss out on dressing up for the occasion!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/8b26a86393b7e2312ca01ff08d10ce70362874b7.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/de8f3dc08781efbd2eeef650e150950a25999155.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/e6a0d4b2b91354ab511edaf7de78c8242e71a3a0.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/2dd4be4949f5f8430c303577e02812ebc57d4b09.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/5b519fe475eab5235063a5756b307bbe37ee8697.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/ebf52f4da442743a8a2ddc480c939ffa15a37fa7.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/791bbda06e2a78bf312fa2699527cb324c325464.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/63c207ff24fd964766315d62acbf66a016e50fd7.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Festive Environment Awaits![/h2]

The factory is now fully immersed in the Lunar New Year spirit, with glowing red lanterns, vibrant firecrackers, and golden decorations everywhere you turn. This touch of festive magic makes your anomaly hunts feel even more thrilling. Who knew the Factory could be so lively?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/26b46c8d05aefcdd7f6f94913cbe3a832d8e169e.jpg[/img]
[h2]New Mode, Coming Soon![/h2]

As you can see, there is one new mode selection when you’re creating a lobby! Assault Mode is coming soon as a [b]FREE UPDATE[/b], where you will survive with fellow agents, alone, or AI companion and endure countless threats. More information about this as we go.

Haven’t joined the hunt yet? Or know someone who’s ready to jump in? Add DreadHaunt to your wishlist now and stay tuned for the upcoming sales the perfect time to start your journey!

Thank you for making DreadHaunt a part of your adventures. May this Lunar New Year bring you prosperity, success, and unforgettable hunts!

notes.title: Jingle All the Way to The Latest Christmas Update
notes.content:
We're having a holiday vibe at the HQ, Agents! And new intel suggests that Santa has already delivered the early Christmas gifts! So here are the updates for this year's Holiday Season.

[h2]Unwrap the FREE Gift![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/ade6d8f7fa13f8c8ad959eab63d6e54354c0b6eb.png[/img]
We heard that the gift contains some holiday-themed costumes for all agents that are also categorized as [b]FREEBIES[/b]!

Don’t forget to unwrap it inside your locker, so you can cozily hunt down the anomalies, in the holiday vibes! 

[h2]Do You Like Sweets? Because Something Just Got Eye-Candier! [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/50c140e8c79ded331e699bcd017cd6a501efdbda.gif[/img]
It’s a fresh look and feel with the revamped UI! Making mode selections smoother and more intuitive. Also, it paves the way for an upcoming new game mode: Assault. 

With this UI update, we hope it will enhance your experience in playing DreadHaunt and we're always open for any feedback you think can improve DreadHaunt.


[h2] Not Just Candies. There are also Gnomes, Sleigh, And Trees![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/c60498fb6245957d3703580e30308f6a3c5cda58.gif[/img]
For unknown reasons, the environments of the Factory understands that the holiday season requires Christmas trees, gift boxes, and of course, gnomes! 

HQ also classified these changes as non-threatening and presumably even liven up your mission onward.

[h2]It’s Christmas, So Here’s Something More![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/cbea87f7904e7016e9de729cd45bae9eaccad304.gif[/img]
As you frantically hunt down them creatures with the agents, you will gain extra points. Yep, you heard it right, Prepare to revel in the joy of [b]DOUBLE XP[/b] during this [b]ENTIRE[/b] festive season!

[h2]Frosty Deal Awaits![/h2]
If you, or your friends-who-you-want-to-play-with, haven’t had DreadHaunt in your Steam library just yet, you can also wishlist it to get notified during the upcoming Steam Winter Sale!

Now that we’ve delivered the updates, we hope you all enjoy the gifts. Thank you so much for supporting DreadHaunt!

Happy Holidays!

:DH

P.S. Follow us and stay up to date on our social media as well to get the latest scoop of the news!

notes.title: DreadHaunt 1.0 Is Here!
notes.content:
Hello Agents!

We're thrilled to announce that DreadHaunt 1.0 is finally here! After months of hard work, dedication, and countless sleepless nights, we're excited to bring you the full vision of a fun yet scary experience.

This update marks a significant milestone for our team. We've poured our hearts and souls into creating a truly haunting experience, and we can't wait to see what you think.

[h1]What's New in 1.0?[/h1]

[h2]New Gameplay Modes: Single Player Campaign[/h2] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/c1b8e7ad1ee4eaba9a41b02b44ffca8531011c62.gif[/img]
Experience the thrills of DreadHaunt, if you dare, in Single Player mode, And dive deeper into the DreadHaunt universe with an expanded lore.

[h2]Expanded Character Roster[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/bc528a019a18950415d750d291efbfca4c234bf8.gif[/img]
DreadHaunt 1.0 features a wider selection of playable characters, both Agents and the Spectromorphs will be unlocked as you play.

[h2][b](Free)[/b] Season Pass: Pilot[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/5b790f03cc736971d180b0176f0ada05afc3be72.jpg[/img]
In addition to new modes, agents, and Spectromorphs, you will also rewarded with more agent costumes, lore entries, titles, alternate NPC ghosts, and many more!

[h1]Thank you[/h1]
We couldn't have made it this far without your incredible support. Thank you for joining us on this terrifying journey. We can't wait to see what horrors await you in DreadHaunt 1.0.

Thank you for your support, and get haunting!

- Digital Happiness :DH

notes.title: By your support, DreadHaunt will leave EA next month!
notes.content:
Hello Agents!

After years of development and iteration, DreadHaunt will leave Early Access in the next month. This all made possible only because of your support over the years. Your input, suggestions, and feedback made this possible. 

[h2]What to Expect[/h2]
This future version of DreadHaunt will add a bunch of new stuff from new cosmetics, characters, and much more. Some significant re-work of the core game and the most anticipated Single Player Campaign will be added. Along with this, there is a ton of re-work and polish and a lot of improvements and fixes.

Some of the newest notable notes are:
[b]Single Player Campaign (Yay!)[/b]
[b]Full Season Pilot Content[/b]

Our previous iterations, including:
[b]New Game modes[/b]
[b]Ghost hunting (solo)[/b]
[b]Ghost Hunting, 2-5P PvE Co-op[/b]
[b]Versus Mode, 3-5P PvP Agents Versus Spectromorph[/b]
[b]Deception mode, 3-5P PvPvE[/b] 

[h2]Price Change[/h2]
Last but not least, Dreadhaunt V 1.0 will be priced at [b]$19,99 USD[/b] after release, Leaving Early Access Pricing from [b]$4,99 USD[/b]
So if you haven’t got DreadHaunt at the EA price, get it now before the price hike next month.

[h2]After All[/h2]
There is still a lot we want to do with DreadHaunt, and plan to heavily support the game forward. But then again despite the shortcomings, we hope you enjoy DreadHaunt as much as we do. As always, please continue to post your feedbacks in the Community Hub. Again, love you all, and thanks for taking the time to support us over the past years.

All the best,
Digital Happiness

notes.title: SOLO / CO-OP MODE IS AVAILABLE! DreadHaunt Update 2024/03/25
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/35e732b3253e0f9989929fafe84c4eceeefbb3a4.png[/img]
Hello agents, 

Today we are releasing an exciting new mode. the Solo / Co-op Mode!!

Some time has passed since DreadHaunt’s last update. In this one, we would like to present you with a new experience in addition to the multiplayer modes. Where you can create and play a session [b]with or without[/b] teammates.

[h1]NEW MODE, THE FIRST-PERSON SOLO / CO-OP MODE[/h1]

- Embark with a fresh viewpoint.
- Exploit a new sets of tools the agency provides.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/6364f3598070c1a3ab52e2542463dbd5766fc662.png[/img]

[h2]- A WHOLE NEW MAP, THE ABANDONED VILLAGE[/h2]

- Explore the abandoned village, with its secrets, and supernatural risks.
- Uncover the burrowed tragedy, untouched for years until the Agency decides to send you.

[h2]- WIELD THE EQUIPMENTS, AND DIVE HEADSTRONG INTO YOUR MISSION[/h2]

- there are three types of important equipment you can wield to help your mission.
    - Handheld UV blaster.
    - Normal Headlight, and the Spectral Headlight.
    - Detector, to indicate the whereabouts of unseen ghosts with audiovisual cue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/47e08837b0bec262b602215f78c92ee7589fb45d.gif[/img]

[h2]- HEAD ON YOUR OWN, OR WITH OTHER AGENTS[/h2]

- play alone, utilizing the core tools by yourself.
- or with teammates, adding support roles to the journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/68eb424c4e81673e9a80ff85c444a752ef568bdf.gif[/img]

[h2]- FIND VARIOUS PARANORMAL EVIDENCE[/h2]

- Find the paranormal evidence to advance the mission progress.
- uncover enough, and maybe you will figure out what happened in this Haunting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/c4fb8a376fe1c790c47c6a4c927c1089842dc366.gif[/img]

[h2]- SHOOT THE EVER-PRESENT APPARITIONS WITH YOUR UV BLASTER[/h2]

- The apparitions are invisible to the naked eye.
- Keep watch of your Detector’s audiovisual cue.
- Utilize your Spectral Headlight to reveal them.
- Banish them with the UV Blaster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/4b6308da1d194998ea8271167fb7ce82dc4603b3.gif[/img]

[h2]- SURVIVE![/h2]

Let us know what you think of this new first-person mode. feedbacks are very welcome!

Join the [url=discord.gg/dreaduniverse]Official Dread Universe Discord[/url] to talk more in-depth and share your experiences. **You can also find other willing agents to play together in the #matchmaking channel.**

[h1]ADDITIONAL INFORMATION[/h1]

[h2]- Bug Fixes and Improvements[/h2]

As usual, We squashed some bugs and fine-tuned several aspects to ensure smooth gameplay. However, don’t hesitate to reach out if you have feedback and suggestions!

[h2]- Future Update Sneak Peek[/h2]

Based on the timeline that we shared, the single-player mode is in the works. We’re also working on the game economy like XP accumulation and cosmetics rewards.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1855580/extras/content_release_plan_fixed.jpg?t=1703069105[/img]

That is all for now. Thank you for your continued support for DreadHaunt!

Best regards :DH

 - Digital Happiness

notes.title: DreadHaunt Update 2023-12-20
notes.content:
Good day, Agents.

We have updated DreadHaunt to version 20231218, and these are notable details that the HQ want to share:

[h2]Post-Session Results Screen[/h2]

After each session, you’ll be presented with an eye-catching post-result screen. Showing who’s the possessed one, who survived (or didn’t), and how many points you racked up during the mission. 

[h2](Ongoing) Audio Updates[/h2]

We decided to overhaul the Audio System including BGM & SFX assets. You will notice a few changes during gameplay

[h2](Ongoing) Controller Support[/h2]

Controller support is available in very early stage. If you the controller-wielding type of agent, we are looking forward to hear your experiences!

[h2]Bug Fixes, Here and There[/h2]

- Added subtitle size option to Settings.
- Spectro damage effect +15%
- Kunti attack charge 25 -> 28.75
- Asih attack charge 10 -> 11.5
- Prevent drop tools while opening voter
- BugFix: Kunti attack charge hit multiple times
- Add condition to disable host quit button when in game
- add descriptions to sprectro skills
- fix mouse cursor not reappearing during waiting for players

[h2]Known Bugs/Glitches[/h2]

- BGM not playing on Versus Mode
- etc.

[h2]Sneak Peek of Future Contents[/h2]

We have a Content Update Plans on the DreadHaunt store page, check it out here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1855580/DreadHaunt/

Last but not least, if you have any suggestions or experienced bugs or glitches about the game, Feel free to reach us out on Steam Community Forum and our official discord server at discord.gg/dreaduniverse

notes.title: Versus, Is a New Mode! - DreadHaunt Early Access Update 2023-11-21
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/c4eeadcd1eaa7c992126bc6eed88d743a8d26744.jpg[/img]
Hello agents,

Today we have updated DreadHaunt to version EA-20231121 which contains:

[h2]Versus Mode[/h2]

notes.title: DreadHaunt Is Now On Early Access!
notes.content:
After long preparation and consideration, we’re excited to announce that DreadHaunt is now available as Early Access on Steam. With your friends or random people, survive the haunting in this multiplayer Co-op & PVP about horror and deception!

DreadHaunt is our first foray into the online horror multiplayer genre. We believe that Early Access will enable us to develop the game further with your feedback. Although, it also means we’re starting the release sooner than our other titles. So if you found any bugs, glitches, and annoyances throughout your journey, it would mean so much if you shared it with us. We invite you to make DreadHaunt a better experience for you, Agent.

Since the last playtest, we gathered valuable data and feedback from you. From that, we made tweaks, optimizations, and polishing throughout the entire game. Which are:

[h1]New Cards System[/h1]

The “cards” represent several gameplay modifiers that you can equip and select at the start of every session. Try it out yourself!

[h1]More Polished Game Assets[/h1]

Compared to the alpha days, game assets such as props and characters have gone through extensive polishing. We’ll polish and add more eye-catching assets as time goes.

[h1]More Tweaks, Here and There[/h1]

We listened to feedback regarding balancing and will continue to do it as more and more people have a try at DreadHaunt.

[b]As seen on the Steam page, here are answers to questions regarding DreadHaunt’s Early Access Release:[/b]

---

[b][h3]Why Early Access?[/h3][/b]

*“We aim to make a unique horror multiplayer game that can be a playground for everyone, both players and us developers. At this stage, we need player feedback and involvement to help us further shape the game.*

*With our decade experience shipping 4 horror titles, we realize that having players involved at this stage would be crucial to shaping this game even better, rather than if kept development internally.”*

[b][h3]Approximately how long will this game be in Early Access?[/h3][/b]

*“Our current plan is to release the game in Q1 2024, however depending on the player's feedback and community suggestions it may change, and we will leave Early Access when we are certain that we can deliver the best version of the game.”*

[b][h3]How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?[/h3][/b]

*“In addition to bug fixes, improvement, and balancing the core gameplay, we plan to add a lot more content to the game. This includes more gameplay Modes (Solo and Single Player), characters, maps, Spectro/ghosts, lore, and much other content that we may get from community feedback.”*

[b][h3]What is the current state of the Early Access version?[/h3][/b]

*“The current build provides players with 6 Characters to choose from, 2 Spectro to choose from, 1 map, 1 gameplay mode, 10 game modifiers cards, 10 customizable emotes and comms, and saving XP that will be useful for the full release. With the XP saved during Early Access, players that were already involved at the Early access would be rewarded at the full release, as a token of appreciation from us”*

[h3]Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?[/h3]

*“The price will not change during early access however we plan to raise the price upon release.”*

[b][h3]How are you planning on involving the Community in your development process?[/h3][/b]

*“We will be pooling all the feedback and suggestions from the Steam community, Discord server, and across our social media. Depending on the reception, we may include voting on future content with the community to decide which one will be included in the next iteration. Private betas will be also considered to be offered to the community and can influence the future shape of the game.”*

---

Stay safe, spread the message, and let’s restore humanity. 

- Digital Happiness

notes.title: DreadHaunt Demo available now
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thanks for checking out our DreadHaunt Demo.
DreadHaunt is our first foray into the online horror multiplayer genre, we are very thrilled to hear what you guys think of our current alpha build Demo. The Demo itself will only available from today until June 20th. The feedback from all of you will be considered and implemented in the final product. 

DreadHaunt [b]will not be[/b] released as free to play games, but instead will be a fully released game with decent enough content to keep us all busy :)

As the development is still in progress, we will continue to improve the final product based on input and suggestions from the community along the way.

After the final product is released, and If the community responds well, we are committed to releasing more content with more game modes, levels, and characters under future DLCs or seasonal passes.

Please consider joining our community for more information and updates.
Appreciate for all of your support.

Much love,
Digital Happiness
